levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عمر بن ميسرة
حسن بن محمد بن علي بن أبي طالب
عبيد الله بن عمر بن ميسرة

notes: Two isnads for the same saying: Asim's route through Hasan, whose source is the unnamed «من شئتم من رجال أسلم»; and Ibn Ishaq's route to Jabir, through the unnamed «رجالا من أسلم» (rule 8)
Doubt: whether the men of Aslam are a transmitter or only the rumour Ibn Ishaq reports; the unnamed surfaces are kept as the gap
«ماعز بن مالك» and the scene are not links
